the hour clock this repository ships.source:
; Lamport, "Specifying Systems", chapter 2: the hour clock.
;   HCini == hr \in 1..12
;   HCnxt == hr' = IF hr # 12 THEN hr + 1 ELSE 1
;   HC    == HCini /\ [][HCnxt]_hr
; The clock has one action, a tick, which is always possible, so every event
; is admissible and every tick is accepted. The invariant is HCini itself.

(deftype Clock (record (hr Int)))
(deftype Event (union (Tick)))
(deftype Outcome (record (state Clock) (accepted Bool)))

(defn valid-state
  (sig ((current Clock)) -> Bool ! pure)
  (examples
    (example (valid-state (Clock 1)) => true)
    (example (valid-state (Clock 12)) => true)
    (example (valid-state (Clock 0)) => false)
    (example (valid-state (Clock 13)) => false))
  (and (>= (.hr current) 1) (<= (.hr current) 12)))

(defn initial
  (sig () -> Clock ! pure)
  (ensures (valid-state result))
  (examples (example (initial) => (Clock 12)))
  (Clock 12))

(defn step
  (sig ((current Clock) (event Event)) -> Outcome ! pure)
  (requires (valid-state current))
  (ensures
    (valid-state (.state result))
    (.accepted result)
    (= (.hr (.state result))
       (if (= (.hr current) 12) 1 (+ (.hr current) 1))))
  (examples
    (example (step (Clock 1) (Tick)) => (Outcome (Clock 2) true))
    (example (step (Clock 11) (Tick)) => (Outcome (Clock 12) true))
    (example (step (Clock 12) (Tick)) => (Outcome (Clock 1) true)))
  (match event
    ((Tick)
      (Outcome (Clock (if (= (.hr current) 12) 1 (+ (.hr current) 1))) true))))

; Lamport, "Specifying Systems", chapter 2: the hour clock.
;   HCini == hr \in 1..12
;   HCnxt == hr' = IF hr # 12 THEN hr + 1 ELSE 1
;   HC    == HCini /\ [][HCnxt]_hr
; The clock has one action, a tick, which is always possible, so every event
; is admissible and every tick is accepted. The invariant is HCini itself.

(deftype Clock (record (hr Int)))
(deftype Event (union (Tick)))
(deftype Outcome (record (state Clock) (accepted Bool)))

(defn valid-state
  (sig ((current Clock)) -> Bool ! pure)
  (examples
    (example (valid-state (Clock 1)) => true)
    (example (valid-state (Clock 12)) => true)
    (example (valid-state (Clock 0)) => false)
    (example (valid-state (Clock 13)) => false))
  (and (>= (.hr current) 1) (<= (.hr current) 12)))

(defn initial
  (sig () -> Clock ! pure)
  (ensures (valid-state result))
  (examples (example (initial) => (Clock 12)))
  (Clock 12))

(defn step
  (sig ((current Clock) (event Event)) -> Outcome ! pure)
  (requires (valid-state current))
  (ensures
    (valid-state (.state result))
    (.accepted result)
    (= (.hr (.state result))
       (if (= (.hr current) 12) 1 (+ (.hr current) 1))))
  (examples
    (example (step (Clock 1) (Tick)) => (Outcome (Clock 2) true))
    (example (step (Clock 11) (Tick)) => (Outcome (Clock 12) true))
    (example (step (Clock 12) (Tick)) => (Outcome (Clock 1) true)))
  (match event
    ((Tick)
      (Outcome (Clock (if (= (.hr current) 12) 1 (+ (.hr current) 1))) true))))

; SPEC.md lines 570-572: a machine-0 descriptor additionally needs checked
; projection and admissibility helpers. The projection selects .state, and
; every typed event is admissible in an invariant state, so the clock can
; always tick.

(defn state-of
  (sig ((produced Outcome)) -> Clock ! pure)
  (examples
    (example (state-of (Outcome (Clock 3) true)) => (Clock 3))
    (example (state-of (Outcome (Clock 12) true)) => (Clock 12)))
  (.state produced))

(defn admissible
  (sig ((current Clock) (event Event)) -> Bool ! pure)
  (examples
    (example (admissible (Clock 1) (Tick)) => true)
    (example (admissible (Clock 12) (Tick)) => true))
  true)

(deftype Reservation (record (reserved Int)))
(deftype Event (union (Reserve) (Release)))
(deftype Outcome (record (state Reservation) (accepted Bool)))

(defn valid-state
  (sig ((current Reservation)) -> Bool ! pure)
  (examples
    (example (valid-state (Reservation 0)) => true)
    (example (valid-state (Reservation 3)) => false))
  (and (>= (.reserved current) 0) (<= (.reserved current) 2)))

(defn initial
  (sig () -> Reservation ! pure)
  (ensures (= result (Reservation 0)))
  (examples (example (initial) => (Reservation 0)))
  (Reservation 0))

(defn step
  (sig ((current Reservation) (event Event)) -> Outcome ! pure)
  (requires (valid-state current))
  (ensures
    (valid-state (.state result))
    (= (.accepted result)
       (match event
         ((Reserve) (< (.reserved current) 2))
         ((Release) (> (.reserved current) 0))))
    (= (.reserved (.state result))
       (+ (.reserved current)
          (if (.accepted result)
              (match event ((Reserve) 1) ((Release) -1))
              0))))
  (examples
    (example (step (Reservation 0) (Reserve)) => (Outcome (Reservation 1) true))
    (example (step (Reservation 2) (Reserve)) => (Outcome (Reservation 2) false))
    (example (step (Reservation 1) (Release)) => (Outcome (Reservation 0) true))
    (example (step (Reservation 0) (Release)) => (Outcome (Reservation 0) false)))
  (match event
    ((Reserve)
      (if (< (.reserved current) 2)
          (Outcome (Reservation (+ (.reserved current) 1)) true)
          (Outcome current false)))
    ((Release)
      (if (> (.reserved current) 0)
          (Outcome (Reservation (- (.reserved current) 1)) true)
          (Outcome current false)))))

; SPEC.md lines 570-572: a machine-0 descriptor additionally needs checked
; projection and admissibility helpers. The projection selects .state, and
; every typed event is admissible in an invariant state; the step's own
; precondition still needs proof.

(defn state-of
  (sig ((produced Outcome)) -> Reservation ! pure)
  (examples
    (example (state-of (Outcome (Reservation 1) true)) => (Reservation 1))
    (example (state-of (Outcome (Reservation 0) false)) => (Reservation 0)))
  (.state produced))

(defn admissible
  (sig ((current Reservation) (event Event)) -> Bool ! pure)
  (examples
    (example (admissible (Reservation 0) (Reserve)) => true)
    (example (admissible (Reservation 2) (Release)) => true))
  true)
